Plot Method for fda_basis Objects

Source: R/basis.R
plot.fda_basis.Rd

Plots all basis functions of a B-spline basis using base R graphics. Each basis function is drawn in a distinct colour.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'fda_basis'
plot(
  x,
  col = NULL,
  lwd = 1.5,
  main = NULL,
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "Basis function value",
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An object of class "fda_basis".

col

Character vector of colours for basis functions. Defaults to a rainbow palette with length equal to n_basis.

lwd

Numeric; line width. Default is 1.5.

main

Character; plot title. Defaults to an informative string.

xlab, ylab

Character; axis labels.

...

Additional arguments passed to graphics::matplot().

Value

Invisibly returns the input object x.

Examples

# \donttest{
x <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)
basis <- bspline_basis(x, n_knots = 10, degree = 3)
plot(basis)

# }
